name: review
description: Waiting for the safety and clarity review

name: open
description: Reviewed and ready for a donor

name: claimed
description: A donor's agent is working on it (6-hour lock)

name: relay
description: Partly done: the next donor continues from the relay note

name: delivered
description: Pull request opened on the requester's repository

name: question
description: A donor's agent is waiting for the requester's answer

name: rejected
description: Refused at review, or PR closed by the requester

name: flagged
description: Reported by a donor's agent; a maintainer checks it
